title: Registering for an evening course
context: You will hear a man registering for an evening language course at a community college.

lines.t: Good afternoon, Brookfield Community College, continuing education. How can I help you?

Hello, I'd like to sign up for one of your evening language courses, please. I tried to do it online, but the website kept freezing. I'm hoping to brush up my Spanish before a trip to Mexico next spring.
Sorry about that. We've been having problems with it all week. I can register you over the phone. Can I have your full name?
Oliver Fairbrother. That's F-A-I-R-B-R-O-T-H-E-R.
And your address, Oliver?
It's Apartment 12, 418 Maple Avenue. People sometimes get those two numbers the wrong way round, so just to be clear, 12 is the apartment and 418 is the building.
Apartment 12, 418 Maple Avenue. And the zip code?
Thank you. Now, which course are you interested in?

Spanish. I did a beginners' course a couple of years ago, and I was thinking of going straight into the advanced class, but I took your online placement test last night and it put me at intermediate level. So I suppose I'd better do that one.
That's sensible. The placement test is usually pretty accurate. We run intermediate Spanish on three evenings, Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, all from seven until nine.
Monday would be easiest for me.
Let me check. Oh, I'm sorry, the Monday group has just filled up.
That's a shame. Thursday's no good either, because I play football on Thursdays. So it'll have to be Tuesday.

Tuesday it is. I should mention the start date. The fall term officially begins on September 2nd, but the Tuesday group starts a week later, on September 9th, because their classroom is being repainted.
So my first class is on the 9th. Fine. And how much is the course?
The full fee is $340. But do you live within the city limits?
Yes, Maple Avenue is in the city.
Then you get the resident's rate, which is $285. That includes all the photocopied materials, but not the course book.
Where can I get the book? Should I just order it online?
You can, but it's usually cheaper at the campus bookstore, because students get a discount there. Most people buy it there in the first week.
Okay, I'll go to the campus bookstore then. Is there parking at the college? I'll be driving straight from work.
There is. You can pay a daily rate of six dollars, but if you're coming every week, it's much better value to buy a parking permit. That's $40 for the whole term.
I'll get the permit, then. Can I add that to the payment now?
Yes, I'll add it. Finally, your classroom. The Tuesday intermediate group is in Room 14, in the Hamilton Building.
Sorry, did you say Hampton?
No, Hamilton. H-A-M-I-L-T-O-N. It's the brick building right next to the main parking lot.
Great. That's really convenient.
So, to confirm, intermediate Spanish on Tuesday evenings, starting September 9th. I'll email you a receipt and a map of the campus.
Thank you very much. You've been really helpful.
You're welcome. Please bring the receipt with you to the first class, because your teacher will need to check the register.
